# EuroTrex

EuroTrex is a mobile trail companion for the E4 in Cyprus. It provides offline trail maps, elevation context, tailored stage planning and verified accommodation near the route.

Hikers do not create website accounts. They use the EuroTrex iOS or Android app.

Accommodation owners can create a website partner account, submit a property, follow its review status and maintain approved information. The EuroTrex team verifies submissions and material updates before publishing them in the mobile app.

Official pages:
- / — product overview and app download links
- /portal — accommodation owner sign-in and listing management
- /partner-terms — accommodation listing standards
- /privacy — website privacy information
